notes: Spatially sorted biofilm layers (microfluidic chip, medium not stated) vs planktonic time course in M63B1 in a shaken 48-well plate reader (carbon source not stated). Planktonic samples are the submitters' reference (is_control true), biofilm false. Planktonic growth_phase by the >=12 h batch rule: 12.95 h and 22.05 h stationary, 25.28 h and 28.08 h late_stationary (inferred; ODs not given, minimal medium so the 12.95 h call is the least certain); 7.62-11.33 h left out. Growth temperature not stated for the chip or the plate (37 C only for the LB subculture). miniBac-seq is a custom low-input total RNA library method, rRNA handling not stated. WT re-read: BW25113 used unmodified.
